event_summary: A small black line figure on a plain light background changes position and orientation while its thin appendages swing through different angles.
raw_event_description: The video shows a small, black, articulated-looking line figure against a mostly blank light background. At the start it is near the upper part of the frame with a circular loop near its center, a near-vertical paired segment above/right, and several thin segments extending leftward and downward. Across the sequence, the figure shifts within the frame and changes orientation; the long paired segment alternates between near-vertical and diagonal positions, while other thin appendages extend and retract visually into different angles. Several frames show the figure blurred during these changes. Near the end, the figure is still intact as a connected cluster of black line segments and loops, with appendages spread in multiple directions on the same light background.

reasons: The small black line figure is visible against a plain light background.
The surrounding scene contains little context beyond the background surface.
The figure appears already present and arranged in a pose at the first frame.
